scripts.export:wp-content: npm run cli rm -- -rf .export/wp-content && mkdir -p .export/wp-content/uploads && run-p export:wp-content:*
scripts.export:db: mkdir -p .export/sql && npm run wp db -- export .export/sql/local.sql
scripts.pretest:php:lint: npm run test:php:start && npm run test-composer -- install --no-interaction
scripts.test:php:lint: wp-env run wordpress --config=.wp-env.tests.json --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/unitone-woocommerce-integrator composer run-script lint
scripts.test:lint:php: npm run test:php:lint || (test_status=$?; npm run test:php:stop; exit $test_status)
scripts.pretest:php:unit: npm run test:php:start && npm run test-composer -- install --no-interaction && npm run test-composer -- install-theme && npm --prefix .themes/unitone ci && npm --prefix .themes/unitone run build && npm run test-composer -- install-plugin
scripts.test:unit:php: npm run test:php:unit || (test_status=$?; npm run test:php:stop; exit $test_status)
scripts.zip:pack: rsync -a --exclude='/vendor' --exclude='/node_modules' --exclude='.*' --exclude='*.ruleset.xml' --exclude='*.config.js' --exclude='*.xml.dist' --exclude='/tests' --exclude='package*.json' . unitone-woocommerce-integrator && wp-env start && npm run composer install -- --no-dev -d unitone-woocommerce-integrator
scripts.zip: npm run clean:zip && npm run zip:pack && npm run zip:archive
scripts.make-pot: wp-env start && npm run wp i18n -- make-pot . ./languages/unitone-woocommerce-integrator.pot -- --exclude=.*,src --debug
